text:
maria: Heads-up — PR #8429 (https://github.com/redwood/qos/pull/8429) fixes scheduler priority inversion causing rare high-latency tails. Need a second reviewer (2nd LGTM) before 16:00 PT cutoff for today's hotfix window. Small change but touches runtime scheduler path, prefer someone familiar with kv-cache or runtime. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

aj: I can take a quick pass in 20m, ping me when CI is green.

ci-bot: CI passed — 34 checks green, integration smoke flaky earlier but rerun passed. Details: https://ci.redwood.internal/build/8429

maria: thx aj. CI is green now. size: 4 changed files, main logic in runtime/scheduler.cpp.

chris: I looked at the diff — logic looks fine, but please add a unit test for the priority bump path if not already present. small race case worth covering.

maria: test added in the PR last commit, see `tests/scheduler/test_priority.py`. Runs quick locally.

sara: I can second for release if chris is comfortable with tests. can you squash/fix the commit message to include the changelog line? tiny nit.

chris: verified test + smoke locally :white_check_mark: — looks good. i'll add the LGTM in a minute.

lee: Heads-up for oncall — if this ships, let's monitor scheduler tail latency and kv-cache hit-rate for 30m post-deploy. I can run the canary dashboard and escalate if needed.

maria: will add rollout note and rollback script in the release body. rollback command for ops: `./ops/rollback --service scheduler --to-tag v2026-03-18-rc` in case.

chris: LGTM

sara: 2nd LGTM from me as well. merging after cutoff if no objections. :rocket:

maria: thanks all — merging now, cutting hotfix branch and tagging. i'll paste deploy link once cut.

deploy-bot: hotfix branch created: `hotfix/qos/8429`. Deployment scheduled: canary at 16:20 PT.

lee: monitoring started, will report if anomalies.

maria: closing thread — thanks team!
